description: Numbers are spoken as words and the invented names come out of a transcriber spelled differently; every paragraph is read in full.

segments.as: Maylis Quillenbrook opened the ledger at page two hundred fourteen and ran her finger down the column for eighteen forty-seven.
Her cousin Tobias Varrow had written three entries in a cramped hand: twelve barrels of salt, forty yards of sailcloth, and one brass astrolabe.
"Farrow never bought anything he could not sell twice," she said, and closed the book on the second of March.
